Name: Tahan, Son of Telah
Summary: Son of Telah and father of Laadan in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:25: Son of Telah and father of Laadan in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Tahan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
